items.title: Last day for the objection (Widerspruch) against the housing-protection order to reach the Bezirksamt
items.quote: Ihr Widerspruch muss spätestens einen Monat nach Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids beim Bezirksamt Beispielbüttel, Grindelberg 62, 20144 Hamburg, eingehen – schriftlich, elektronisch mit qualifizierter Signatur oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 2026-04-02, no separate posting date. Posted after 1 Jan 2025, so it is deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting: Mon 2026-04-06 (Easter Monday). A city district office is a general authority, so the delivery day does not move. Period of one month starts 2026-04-07 and ends on the same day number one month later: Wed 2026-05-06. That is not a weekend or a Hamburg holiday, so there is no shift.

warnings: The order to stop short-term holiday letting has no fixed compliance date in the letter, and non-compliance may lead to a Zwangsgeld (coercive fine); an objection does not necessarily suspend the duty, so check with the office or a lawyer.
The objection must actually reach the Bezirksamt by the deadline; sending it on that day is not enough.
If today is later than 2026-05-06 (the system gave conflicting 'today' dates, 2026-04-08 and 2026-09-30), the objection period has probably expired, and you should seek legal advice promptly.
